name: Molling

attributes.attribute: an Irish saint of the seventh century
foster brother of the hero Fionn mac Cumhaill
his church was built by Goban Saor from sacred trees
the mad king Suibhne died at his church

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Molling, or Saint Molling, is an Irish legendary figure who lived in the seventh century. He was taken into the tales of Fionn mac Cumhaill, who is said to be the saint's foster brother. Goban Saor, the magical smith, built Molling's church from trees held sacred. It was at that church that king Suibhne died, after living as a madman. Such mythology often gathers around a real person, in order to widen his sacred power.
